name: Cable Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
steps: Stand just in front of a low pulley and hold its bar behind your thighs with your palms facing back.
Bend both wrists to curl the bar toward the backs of your forearms.
Uncurl your wrists slowly and let the bar descend.
tips: Keep your elbows locked straight and shoulders still so only your wrists move.
Control the bar slowly on the way down instead of letting the stack pull your fingers open.
